# Prime Pest Control Dubai

> Professional pest and bird control company serving all communities across Dubai, UAE. Licensed technicians, same-day service, 100% satisfaction guarantee. Call or WhatsApp 055 304 5256.

## About

Prime Pest Control Dubai provides direct pest and bird control services for homes, villas, apartments, restaurants, hotels, and commercial properties across all Dubai communities. We eliminate cockroaches, bed bugs, termites, rodents, ants, mosquitoes, wasps, fleas, scorpions, and 50+ other pests. We also specialise in bird control including pigeons, mynahs, crows and sparrows using netting, spikes and deterrents.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How quickly can you respond in Dubai?**
We are available 24/7 and offer same-day and next-day appointments across Dubai. We typically reply within minutes via WhatsApp.

**How much does pest control cost in Dubai?**
Prices start from AED 299 depending on the type of pest, property size and severity. We provide free, no-obligation quotes with upfront AED pricing and no hidden fees.

**Are your treatments safe for children and pets?**
Yes. We use products and methods that are safe for families and pets when applied as directed. Our technicians advise on any precautions needed before and after treatment.

**Do you offer a satisfaction guarantee?**
Yes. We offer a 100% satisfaction guarantee on all services. If the problem persists after treatment, we return and re-treat at no additional cost.

**Which areas in Dubai do you cover?**
We cover all Dubai communities including Dubai Marina, Downtown, JBR, Business Bay, Jumeirah, Palm Jumeirah, DIFC, Deira, Bur Dubai, Al Barsha, Mirdif, Dubai Hills, and more.

**Do I need to know what pest I have?**
No. Just describe what you are seeing. Our experts will identify the pest and recommend the right treatment.
